suture.name: SUTURE
suture.desc: Black thread that knows where the wound is.

lexicon_core.name: LEXICON CORE
lexicon_core.desc: An index of every name the dead were given. Strike a thing and it answers.
lexicon_core.effect: Shows the name and health of what she hits.

wall_jump.name: GRIP SERVOS
wall_jump.desc: Pulled from the werewolf's claws. Her legs remember how it climbed.
wall_jump.effect: Jump at a wall and hold toward it to cling; jump again to kick off.

elegy_013.name: ELEGY-013
elegy_013.desc: The Pallbearer's scythe. It was made to carry the dead; now it makes them.

soul_orb.name: SOUL ORB
soul_orb.desc: A pale light that drifts where something died.

scrap.name: SCRAP
scrap.desc: Bolts and plate torn from the machines. Self-repair runs on it.
